name: AppFlowy
description: AppFlowy is an open-source workspace and note-taking app built on Flutter and Rust. It gives you the block-based editing and database views of Notion, but with local-first storage and full data ownership. A strong pick for privacy-minded teams and individuals.
highlights: Block editor with docs, boards, and calendars
curatorNote: AppFlowy is the local-first Notion alternative that keeps shipping. For anyone who wants their notes on their own disk, it is the most credible option.
